generation.prompt: Create ONE original front-view diffuse face texture for a low-resolution hand-painted fantasy strategy-game human infantry model. A rugged mortal man around 35, weathered warm olive-brown skin, strong angular cheekbones and brow, dark brown eyes with small clear highlights, straight compact human nose, closed calm mouth, short dark chestnut beard and cropped brushed hair. Head facing EXACTLY straight forward, vertical and symmetrical in perspective, no tilt, no shoulders, no helmet, no ears outside the head outline. Head top at image y=5%, chin at y=95%, eye line at y=41%, mouth at y=72%. Entire face centered, maximum head width ~90% of square image. Transparent background. Flat diffuse albedo, painted warm midtones and restrained darker plane divisions, tiny stippled brushwork, clear light eyelids and mouth, not glossy plastic, not black eye cavities, not a photoreal portrait, no dramatic lighting. It must look like a detailed late-1990s oil-painted game face surface, intended to be planar projected over an ORIGINAL genuinely articulated 3D head; do not depict the body, weapons, scenery or text.

producer.replay: In an isolated project copy, restore this exact snapshot to scripts/targon_humanoid_art.py and run the recorded Blender unit command

registration.method: Independent fixed compact camera, no per-frame bbox fit
